name: AEM
summary: α-Ethylmescaline (AEM or 3,4,5-trimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine) is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and phenylisobutylamine families related to the psychedelic drug mescaline. It is the analogue of mescaline and TMA with an ethyl group at the α position of the side chain.

pharmacology.text: AEM produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents, but with only about half the potency of mescaline and TMA (α-methylmescaline).

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study how the structure of mescaline-like drugs affects their activity.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於研究類麥司卡林藥物的結構如何影響活性。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于研究类麦司卡林药物的结构如何影响活性。

fact.en: Mescaline, from the peyote cactus, carries a methyl group at the α position in TMA. AEM has an ethyl group there instead, and in rodent tests that makes it weaker rather than stronger.
fact.zh: 在TMA中，源自佩奧特仙人掌的麥司卡林骨架在α位置上帶有一個甲基。AEM在那裡換成乙基，而在鼠類測試中，這讓它變弱而不是變強。
fact.zhHans: 在TMA中，源自佩奥特仙人掌的麦司卡林骨架在α位置上带有一个甲基。AEM在那里换成乙基，而在鼠类测试中，这让它变弱而不是变强。
